slug: 2026-02-11 Egypt finalises Executive Regulations to the PDPL (Decree 816-2025)

facts.fact: Access Partnership says Executive Regulations No. 816/2025 under Law No. 151/2020 were issued by Ministerial Decree on 1 November 2025.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: Access Partnership says enforcement of the law is expected from 1 November 2026, the end of a one-year grace period (date is the document's published date).
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: Access Partnership says the regulations confirm the Personal Data Protection Center as the supervisory authority for implementation, monitoring and enforcement.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

systems.system: Executive Regulations of the PDPL (Decree No. 816 of 2025)
